items.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손

assessments.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or material internal-control failure was identified through the cutoff; KPMG has audited the company since 2018. Governance concentration and SBC are risks, not evidence of integrity failure.
cutoff까지 재작성, 감사인 분쟁, 중대한 내부통제 실패가 확인되지 않았다. IPO-era SBC와 company-defined FCF의 차이는 공시된 경제적 조정 문제이지 회계 신뢰 훼손 사건 자체는 아니다.
Rubrik has positive OCF/FCF and about $1.75B liquidity, while the 0% convertible does not mature until 2030. Operations do not currently require repeated external financing to survive.
H1 OCF가 양수이고 현금+단기투자가 convert 원금을 상회하며 만기는 2030년이다. 현재 운영이 반복 외부자본 없이는 존속 불가능하다는 두 구성요건이 성립하지 않는다.

Dilution is material—about 5% y/y outstanding-share growth and high SBC—but the evidence does not yet establish a long-duration structural pattern. This risk is reflected in dilution_offbalance=30 and must be re-tested annually.

Current dilution is material but only a limited post-IPO history is available; a long-duration pattern is not yet established. RF therefore penalizes FCF/share quality rather than confirming the veto.

NRR >119%, 33% ARR growth, 23% large-customer growth and improving contribution margin show repeat customer expansion and economic value. High S&M is a risk but does not establish growth without customer value.
NRR >119%, ARR +33%, large-customer +23%, 78.4% gross margin과 contribution-margin 개선은 반복 고객가치를 입증한다. 높은 S&M은 효율 리스크지만 고객가치 부재의 증거는 아니다.
Incremental ROIC is not reliably measurable yet, but ARR growth and contribution-margin improvement do not show a structural collapse. Uncertainty is scored at 50 rather than converted into a veto.
RF에서 증분 ROIC를 신뢰성 있게 측정하지 못해 50을 부여했지만 ARR와 contribution margin이 개선 중이다. '불확실'을 '자본비용 아래 구조적 붕괴'로 승격할 증거는 없다.

Observed ARR, cloud ARR, enterprise-customer count and NRR are all expanding, while third-party category recognition remains strong. Commoditization risk exists but sustained moat contraction is not observed.
NRR, ARR, cloud ARR, 대형 고객 수가 증가하고 MT는 77로 강화 방향을 보인다. 경쟁·번들링 위험은 있으나 지속적 해자 축소가 관측되지는 않았다.

items.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구

assessments.rationale: Frozen price $106.71 is far below locked Bull value $563.05; the defined Bull+ price condition is not met.
Frozen price $106.71 is far below the locked Bull value of about $563.05. The defined veto requires current price to exceed the Bull value, which is not satisfied.
Frozen $106.71은 locked Bull $563.05보다 크게 낮다. Base의 terminal 의존과 Bear 하방은 valuation/asymmetry 위험이지만 정의상 current price > Bull은 아니다.

items.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성

assessments.rationale: Channel concentration is high, but no ultimate end customer >25% is disclosed and the platform spans data, identity, cloud/SaaS and emerging agent security. Fatal single-factor dependence is not demonstrated.
채널 파트너 집중은 높지만 ultimate end-customer >25%는 확인되지 않았고 data, identity, cloud/SaaS, agent security로 제품 범위가 확장 중이다. 단일 요인 상실 시 회복 불가능한 사업경제 훼손은 입증되지 않았다.

items.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음

assessments.rationale: Bear valuation implies severe price impairment, but current liquidity, positive operating cash flow and a 0% convertible due 2030 do not support an excessive bankruptcy probability. The price-risk penalty remains in permanent_loss=50.

Net liquidity is positive, near-term debt service is minimal, maturity is 2030 and operating cash flow is positive. Price impairment risk is large, but current bankruptcy risk does not meet the veto definition.

basis.direction: 27개 전부 gpt-5.6-sol >= Claude Opus 5. 노이즈가 아니라 계통 편향.
basis.caveat: 표본은 종목 1개다. 다른 종목의 쌍 실행이 쌓이면 base_offset을 재추정해야 한다. harness.py calibrate로 측정한다.

dispersion_review.metric: scored 도메인 전체에 대한 skew = (score - bear_score) - (bull_score - score) 의 평균. 양수면 하방 폭이 더 넓다는 뜻이다.

archetype_rationale: Highest eligible deterministic fit; ties use configured priority
falsifiers: Reduce upside_path if ARR growth drops below 20% before SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share turns positive.
Treat the 5x path as broken if Agent Cloud remains immaterial and core customer expansion falls below 110% NRR.
Raise permanent-loss risk if net liquidity erodes materially while dilution remains above 5% annually.
Cut retention_usage if NRR falls below 110% or large-customer growth falls below 10%.
Cut unit_economics if contribution margin stalls while S&M remains above 50% of revenue.
Escalate dependency risk if one ultimate end customer exceeds 25% of revenue.
Cut adoption_curve if ARR growth falls below 20% and NRR below 110% for two quarters.
Cut optionality if Agent Cloud remains commercially immaterial through FY2028.
Cut cost_performance_shift if independent benchmarks show no material recovery/TCO advantage versus bundled alternatives.
ARR 성장 <20%, NRR <110%, 대형고객 성장 <10%가 동시에 나타나면 장기 성장·고객가치 근거를 재평가한다.
연간 희석이 5% 이상 지속되고 SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share가 개선되지 않으면 FS/RF/AS를 재실행한다.
refrozen valuation에서 Base가 현재가 이하로 내려가거나 terminal fraction이 더 높아지면 expectation-gap 근거를 약화한다.
Cut Base materially if Subscription ARR growth falls below 20% before owner FCF/share turns sustainably positive after SBC.
Cut Base if diluted economic share count grows above 5% annually for two consecutive years without commensurate per-share cash growth.
Raise the durability case only if owner FCF/share turns positive while ARR growth remains above 25% and retention stays above 115%.
Raise FS if annual share growth falls below 3% while SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share turns positive.
Lower FS if cash plus investments fall below convertible principal before owner FCF becomes sustainably positive.
Escalate external-capital risk if operating cash flow turns negative for multiple quarters while growth spending remains required.
Opportunity scale falls below 2x if normalized revenue growth drops below the mid-teens within two years.
Cut growth_duration below 65 if ARR growth drops below 20% before Agent Cloud is material.
Cut market_misperception if refrozen Base value falls near or below price without a shorter duration assumption.
Cut capital_allocation if Predibase remains immaterial while dilution persists above 5%.
Cut governance_integrity on any restatement, material weakness or auditor dispute.
Cut execution_adaptability if repeated guidance misses follow the current expansion phase.
Restore pacing toward 1.0 if geopolitical severity normalizes and financial conditions ease without credit stress.
Tighten further if HY OAS rises above 400bp or enterprise software funding conditions deteriorate sharply.
Trigger domain reanalysis only if a structural event directly matches RBRK's frozen region/dependency tokens.
Cut switching_pricing if NRR falls below 110%.
Cut network_data_ecosystem if large-customer and cloud-ARR growth both fall below 10%.
Escalate moat-shrinkage risk if bundled alternatives cause persistent gross-retention losses.
Raise incremental_roic only when owner FCF/share turns positive while ARR stays above 20%.
Cut reinvestment_runway if ARR growth falls below 15% despite reinvestment above OCF.
Confirm dilution veto if >5% annual share growth persists for multiple years without per-share cash growth.
NRR >115%와 ARR 성장 >25%가 지속되면서 희석 <3%, SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share 양전환이면 핵심 숏 논리는 크게 약화된다.
Agent Cloud가 독립적으로 유의미한 ARR와 retention을 공개하면 '인접가치풀은 서사뿐'이라는 숏 논리는 약화된다.
반대로 ARR 성장 <20%와 >5% 희석이 동시에 지속되면 영구손실·외부자본·해자 관련 veto를 재검토한다.
Cut secular_durability if normalized ARR growth falls below 15% for multiple quarters.
Cut category_leadership if third-party position weakens and large-customer growth stalls.
Raise durability_risks only after a second independent end market exceeds 10% of revenue.
